reviews.title: GREAT APP…
reviews.text:
…Questionable Tactics. Zero Support.

Let’s start with the good news.

It’s an excellent app. The UI is intuitive, smooth, and refreshingly straightforward. AI is woven into virtually everything, and the overall experience is impressive.

And then comes the catch.

It’s a paid app. Accept that as an axiom, and stop complaining.

Here are the three subscription tiers:

• Basic: 20 AI prompts, core features only — $40/year
• Plus: 50 AI prompts, all features, and Family Sharing — $60/year
• Pro: Unlimited AI prompts — $30/month

So far, so good, right?

Not quite.

1. Customer support? Apparently, a one-star review is your ticket.

There seems to be no readily available App Support. If you want your problem addressed, your best chance appears to be posting a one-star review right here on the App Store. Only then might someone show up to respond.

An extraordinary approach to customer service, wouldn’t you agree?

2. The Lifetime Unlimited offer: a siren song with a price tag that keeps changing.

Exploring the app reminded me of the Sirens in Homer’s Odyssey: irresistible invitations beckoning unsuspecting sailors toward danger. In this case, the danger is a purchasing decision made without a clear understanding of what you’re actually getting.

The app repeatedly tempts you with invitations to purchase “Unlimited Lifetime.”

“Come, sailors! Claim Unlimited Lifetime!”

Sounds wonderful. Until you look closer.
